scope: Independent Math roadmap, not contingent on AURA adoption

milestones.title: Foundation and Discovery

work_streams.title: Math Discovery
work_streams.scope: Reconcile pre-existing M3-W03 draft; qualify opt-in CLR bindings, schema-2 conformance and deterministic generated skill
acceptance: Pinned 13-case portable corpus is independently verified
Selected CLR signatures and examples compile from current assemblies
Only opted-in AgentCallable metadata is emitted; no BrokerReady or broker authorization claim
Generator output is byte-stable and drift is rejected

work_streams.title: .NET 11 and C# 15 modernization
work_streams.scope: Audit SDK and API changes; qualify net11 consumer and safe targeted migrations of existing 13 libraries
acceptance: Verify installed stable SDK and Microsoft primary-source specifications on execution day
Record package graph, target framework, language and analyzer changes
Targeted build/test and source-free local consumer receipts before shipping net11 packages
Do not mutate or overwrite historical immutable NuGet packages

milestones.exit_gate: Qualified Discovery seed and independent net11/C#15 compatibility decision; no implicit cross-repository adoption

milestones.title: Scientific Quantities

work_streams.title: Versioned scientific constants
work_streams.scope: Canonical source/licensing audit; exact definitions versus measured uncertain values; provenance and revisions
acceptance: Every constant has a traceable primary source and version
Uncertainty and dimensions are typed, never silently exactified

work_streams.title: Discipline-specific opt-in unit profiles
work_streams.scope: Electromagnetism, thermodynamics, mechanics, chemistry and photometry under explicit conflict and alias policy
acceptance: Units have exact dimension/scale/offset identity where justified
No implicit alias or historical catalogue changes

milestones.exit_gate: Independent package and source-free consumer validation; preserved old catalogues

work_streams.title: Precision and interval contracts
work_streams.scope: Arbitrary precision policy, enclosure arithmetic and uncertainty propagation
acceptance: Bounded precision, allocation and cancellation
Independent exact/interval oracles; rounding direction and invalid domains explicit

work_streams.title: Tensor and numerical algorithm candidates
work_streams.scope: Finite typed tensor shapes and targeted algorithms selected by evidence, not an unbounded engine
acceptance: Shape/budget refusals, numerical stability and independent consumer qualification
Explicit exact-to-approximate policy

milestones.title: Computation and Interoperability

work_streams.title: Bounded local computation DAG
work_streams.scope: Acyclic typed DAG, shared subexpressions, deterministic replay and partial result statuses
acceptance: Cycle and budget refusal; reproducible node provenance
No distributed scheduler, credentials or AURA resource policy

work_streams.title: Formal and exchange boundaries
work_streams.scope: Qualified bounded formal exchange and canonical codecs, no general theorem prover
acceptance: Reject unknown schema/domain variants; round-trip known subset
No equivalence claim from structural hashes alone

milestones.exit_gate: Selected local computation and formal/exchange contracts verified

work_streams.title: OS/RID portability and reproducibility
work_streams.scope: Windows/Linux/macOS test matrix as available, architecture limits and deterministic local NuGet closures
acceptance: Independent OS evidence with precise SDK/RID
Immutable package checksums and unsupported platforms explicitly declared

work_streams.title: Capability documentation and gated delivery
work_streams.scope: Per-capability contracts, generated docs, compatibility and release/license decisions
acceptance: Examples compile from published packages and boundaries are discoverable
Owner-authorized release only after rights and support matrix review

initial_gate.preferred_next: M8-W01 Discovery compatibility/topology audit, then M8-W02 runtime modernization in separate runs
